match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. medium wide. eye level. Scarlett moves through the crosswalk on the center third, taxis and office towers layered behind her, phone raised and coffee held in the foreground. Scarlett has just stepped into the crowded crosswalk, filming herself with one hand while keeping her coffee level with the other. Then: Scarlett walks against the flow as a gust catches her scarf and she grabs it. Camera: handheld truck, smooth. Characters: Scarlett: Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height with a slim, active build, warm medium skin, expressive dark eyes, and dark brown hair worn loose to the shoulders. Her face is youthful, with defined brows and a quick, open smile. Her appearance becomes visibly brighter as the coral lipstick brings color to her complexion, wearing Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried or worn. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, correct perspective and depth, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Figures have readable poses, gestures and simple expressive faces. Draw the single opening moment of the shot: each character appears exactly once, and what happens next is shown only by a few bold arrows for the camera move and the way subjects travel. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
